### Quick comparison of the big three

| Provider       | Best for                              | Strengths                                      | Watch-outs                              | Typical sweet spot                  |
|----------------|---------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| **AWS**       | Broadest use cases, startups to enterprise | Most services & regions, mature ecosystem, huge community, marketplace | Can get complex/expensive; pricing labyrinth | General-purpose, everything-as-a-service |
| **Microsoft Azure** | Microsoft shops, enterprises, hybrid | Excellent Active Directory/Office 365/Windows integration, strong hybrid (Arc), enterprise agreements, AI (OpenAI partnership) | Can feel Windows-centric; portal complexity | .NET, Windows, regulated enterprises |
| **Google Cloud (GCP)** | Data, analytics, AI/ML, Kubernetes   | Best-in-class BigQuery, TensorFlow/Vertex AI, clean Kubernetes (GKE), often competitive pricing & networking | Smaller service catalog & market share than AWS/Azure; fewer enterprise legacy tools | Data-heavy, ML, cloud-native apps |
